scope: Comparison of documented evidence, not equivalence certification
rows: What it is / 是什么
Our engineering reconstruction in ce-cad, combining source meshes with rebuilt parts. Not certified 1:1. / 我们的ce-cad工程重建，混合参考网格与重建零件，未证明1:1。
Independent community reconstruction by fanhao375. Public design/research files do not mean a completed robot. / fanhao375独立复刻研究，公开文件不代表整机完成。
Pollen Robotics commercial robot. Software and some electronics are public; this is not a complete publicly released manufacturing definition. / Pollen商业机器人，软件及部分电子资料公开，但不是完整公开制造定义。
Servos / 舵机
15 × ROBOTIS Dynamixel XL330-M288-T in our current model and parts list. / 当前模型和清单采用15个XL330-M288-T。
Baseline BOM specifies 15 × XL330-M288-T. HD-1910-C001 is a separate Feetech alternative under discussion. / 基线清单为15个XL330；飞特HD-1910-C001是另一路替代方案。

Official runtime README says fifteen servos; public simulation supports the XL330-family inference. Exact fitted motor variant in the reviewed commercial unit remains unconfirmed. / 官方运行时说明15个舵机，公开模型支持XL330系列推断；目标实物具体型号未确认。
Mechanics and fit / 机械与装配
Reconstructed geometry and mesh repairs must retain evidence and new revisions. Assembly, interference and strength coverage are still incomplete. / 重建和网格修复需保留证据及版本；装配、干涉、强度尚未全部验证。
Derived from public simulation meshes/MJCF. Printed shells, legs and feet and some leg screw fit are documented; that is not proof of every interface. / 来自公开仿真网格，已记录部分打印和腿部螺钉试装，并非所有接口验证。

Manufacturer demonstrates working robots. Published simulation geometry does not certify original manufacturing tolerances, fasteners or the exact production revision. / 厂商展示了工作实机；公开仿真几何不代表生产公差、紧固件或具体版本。
Electronics / 电子
Public HAT C1 source is pinned, but our model differs from that board revision. Our historical HAT/IMU reconstructions have unresolved checks. / 公开HAT C1来源已固定，但当前网格板卡版本不同；旧HAT/IMU重建仍有未解决检查项。
Public HAT reference plus a separate self-designed IMU. Its README explicitly says no prototype or physical verification yet. / 参考公开HAT，另自行设计IMU；作者明确说明IMU未打样、未实物验证。
Working electronics exist in the product; public HAT sources alone do not establish the installed HAT, IMU, camera or ToF revision. / 产品有工作电子系统，但公开HAT文件不能确定目标实机所有板卡版本。
Software and control / 软件与控制
ce-cad engineering review/simulation and archived upstream control sources. No completed walking validation on our physical robot. / ce-cad工程审查和仿真，加上上游控制资料；我们的实机尚未完成行走验证。
Studies/reuses upstream control architecture. Alternative servos require motor protocol, calibration and policy validation; source compatibility is not hardware proof. / 研究复用上游架构；换舵机需验证协议、标定和策略。
Official Rust runtime drives fifteen servos at 50 Hz; official RL repository uses MuJoCo/PPO and exports ONNX policies. / 官方Rust运行时以50 Hz控制15个舵机，MuJoCo/PPO训练并导出ONNX策略。
Physical evidence / 实物证据
Review files and software checks are available; they do not establish a mechanically complete, powered and walking replica. / 有审查文件和软件检查，但不代表整机已完成、可通电行走。
Printed-part and limited fit evidence; the pinned sources do not prove a complete walking replica. / 有打印及有限装配证据，所固定资料不能证明整机行走。
Manufacturer videos demonstrate walking and other behaviors. We have not independently tested the exact production unit being compared. / 厂商视频展示行走等动作；我们没有独立测试此处对应的具体出厂实机。
Version control / 版本管理
Project Git history plus immutable numbered reviews and file hashes. A working-tree render is not automatically a frozen release. / Git历史加不可变审查版本和文件哈希；工作区渲染并非自动冻结发布。
Git checkout pinned to a1f4979c425b. Older mechanical archive 2549257 is separately retained. / 固定Git提交，旧机械归档2549257另行保留。
Official runtime, RL and HAT repositories have Git histories. Those commits do not identify a physical product serial number or full production BOM. / 官方软件和HAT有Git历史，但提交不等于实物序列号或完整生产BOM。
